meta.name: create-imessage-mockup
meta.description: Render pixel-accurate iMessage screenshot mockups (DM or group) from a thread JSON. Supports minimal, with-keyboard, and full iPhone 15 Pro frame variants. Outputs HTML + PNG.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话文本生成逼真的 iMessage 截图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速制作高保真 iMessage 对话截图用于展示或测试
copy.tagline_en: Generate realistic iMessage screenshots from conversation text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create high-fidelity iMessage conversation screenshots for demos or testing

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你提供的对话 JSON 生成逼真的 iMessage 截图，支持单聊或群聊，可选择纯气泡、带键盘或带 iPhone 15 Pro 手机框三种样式，输出 HTML 和 PNG 文件。
howto.when: 当你需要为广告、社交媒体或视频场景制作假的 iMessage 截图时触发。你需要先提供对话的 JSON 文件，Claude 会帮你生成截图。

say.text: 帮我生成一个两人聊天的 iMessage 截图，带键盘。
say.note: Claude 会要求你提供对话内容，然后生成截图。

say.text: 创建一个群聊截图，显示“已送达”状态，带 iPhone 框。
say.note: Claude 会生成带手机边框的群聊截图。

say.text: 生成一个只有气泡的极简 iMessage 截图。
say.note: Claude 会生成不带键盘和手机框的纯气泡截图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate realistic iMessage screenshots from a thread JSON you provide, supporting DM or group chats, with three styles: minimal bubbles, with keyboard, or with iPhone 15 Pro frame. Outputs HTML and PNG.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need a fake iMessage screenshot for ads, social posts, or video scenes. You must provide a thread JSON; Claude will compose and render the screenshot.

say_en.text: Generate an iMessage screenshot for a two-person chat with keyboard.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for the conversation content and generate the screenshot.

say_en.text: Create a group chat screenshot with 'Delivered' status and iPhone frame.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a group screenshot with phone bezel.

say_en.text: Generate a minimal iMessage screenshot with bubbles only.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a screenshot without keyboard or frame.
